summary: Cold iteration-1 codegen for sranger: 9 Java files, all 23 requirements traced; 6 judgement calls surfaced for review.

issues.title: Final has a tick self-loop not named by any requirement
issues.raw: SR-FR3 calls Final terminal; SR-DC1 says SR-Beh1..7 are the only transitions. The codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm Final should accept tick as a no-action self-transition (an 8th transition with no requirement), or specify Final's intended behaviour.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning: event trigger vs guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 fires on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) guards the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as obstacle event AND obstacleDetected. Confirm the conjunction is intended.

issues.title: Clock time base is milliseconds
issues.raw: SR-Var1 states clockResetTime in seconds; the Clock dependency exposes nowMs().
issues.fix_directive: clockResetTime is stored in ms and compared with TURN_DURATION_MS = 2000.0 (= turnDuration 2.0 s). Confirm or require a seconds time base.

issues.title: No-reading distance default = 1000 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 asks for 'a large default value' without a number.
issues.fix_directive: NO_READING_DISTANCE = 1000.0 in SRangerConstants; negative readings clamp to 0.

issues.title: Transition priority
issues.raw: Requirements give no priority between endTask, obstacle, the timed transition and tick.
issues.fix_directive: endTask first in every mode; in Turning the timed transition outranks the tick self-loop.

issues.title: Initial Moving entry command issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1 requires Move(moveVel, 0) on entering Moving, including at power-up (SR-Beh1).

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
